packageRules.description: Automerge non-major updates once the nix gate is green. Majors keep a human. Placed last on purpose: renovate/all.json ends with a kill-switch rule (automerge: false for every package) and a repository's own rules apply after its extends, so this one wins (seven ADR 036). Do not move it into a shared preset: that would turn automerge on for every consumer. Safe because `main` requires `nix / ✅ nix gate` (branch protection). platformAutomerge is off so Renovate itself merges.
Docker and Helm updates only take effect at deploy time, so merging them unattended proves nothing the gate checks. Keep them manual.
